meta.source: offline snapshot decompile-results/full_export/src/*.cpp (19088 functions parsed) + FP constant bytes decoded from D:/RA2MD/gamemd.exe (.rdata VA range 0x7E1000-0x812000)

method.FPC: FP-constant linkage: (a) producer form — fld of a .rdata FP constant (dbl_/flt_/qword_/unk_ in .rdata, decoded finite) on the x87 virtual-stack top when a member FPU mem-op touches [base+off] -> pointee float (dword/float prefix) / double (qword/double prefix); (b) const-op form — fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv/fcom/fcomp with ds:<const> operand whose stack-top producer is a member FP load -> that member float/double. Constant semantics identified against a physical-constant table (pi, 0.5, 1/256, 2^-31, ...) with float32-aware tolerance for flt_ (4-byte) consts.
method.FZ: special loaders fldz(0.0)/fld1(1.0)/fldpi(pi)/fldln2/fldl2e/fldl2t as stack-top producer at a member FPU mem-op -> member float/double. (yield 0 in this binary: fldz/fld1/fldpi occur only in CRT internals, never adjacent to resolvable member ops — recorded as class definition, kept for completeness)
method.PAIR: x87 stack pairing at fmulp: two top virtual-stack producers both FP loads (fld) with EQUAL size prefix -> float x float / double x double same-type proof, both operand entities typed. (yield 0: MSVC 6 codegen never emits fld,fld,fmulp with two FP loads in this binary — the only strict triple is fild x fild at 0x65B534/0x65B537 (int x int, typed via CVT individually); fmulp producer-pair histogram in counts.pair_diag)
method.CVT: fild/fistp [base+off] -> member int (dword prefix -> int; word -> short). Integer memory operand of the FPU proves the slot holds an integer that gets converted to/from FP. qword (64-bit int) occurrences have no closed-vocabulary spelling -> counted, not emitted.
method.FIM: fiadd/fisub/fisubr/fimul/fidiv/fidivr [base+off] -> member int (same integer-memory-operand proof as CVT, mechanically identical; separate kind in raw stats, merged under CVT spelling in evidence)
method.engine: linear x87 virtual-stack simulation over snapshot disasm; producers per slot: const(.rdata FP literal)/special(fldz family)/memfp/memint/other. Reset at function boundary, labels, unconditional jmp, ret, call, fninit, fsave/frstor/fnstenv/fldenv; conditional branches do NOT reset (state describes the fallthrough path; every jump target starts at a label, which resets). Under-simulation can only under-report producers (sound for proof).
method.entity_attribution: linear this-alias scan (entry prefix + def/kill; anchors/fn_takes_this.json gate) + backward same-block def-scan for base registers (alignscale engine). Forms: M:FN:this:0xOFF / PP:FN:k:0xOFF (param pointee; direct named arg slot at off 0 -> PP:FN:k:0x0) / GP:ADDR:0xOFF / merged nested M. Numeric esp/ebp offsets skipped (ffl10 drift lesson); var_N local slots suppressed (noise); base defined before block head -> unresolved (counted, 374 sites).
method.materialization: inline (ffl8 mat_pointee semantics): T+off->M:FN:this:off | M:A+off->merged | P+off->PP | G+off->GP; off<0 or (off==0 non-slot) skipped.
method.soundness: closed-vocabulary types asserted; entity contradiction (e.g. fild int vs fld dword float on same ent) -> entity dropped and counted (ffl8 policy); FPC producers gated to .rdata (file-backed constants, independent binary evidence — .data dbl_ refs are runtime-initialized variables and are excluded from const decoding); fld of .data globals pushes other (name-derived typing is circular, not used).
